headline: Executive order creates a presidential advisory group called the 1776 Commission.
what_it_does: This order sets up an advisory commission, named the President's Advisory 1776 Commission, to give advice to the President. No summary was provided, so details about the commission's members, duties, and goals are not available here.
when_it_takes_effect: Signed November 2, 2020; no separate start date was provided.
